story.x: Flipper One runs on completely open-source Linux firmware with a mainline kernel. This means full compatibility with the latest kernel versions:
story.z: Flipper One 在带有主线内核的完全开源 Linux 固件上运行。这意味着与最新内核版本完全兼容：

story.x: *   Mainline Linux kernel support — full support in upstream Linux kernel.
story.z: * 主线 Linux 内核支持 — 上游 Linux 内核的完全支持。

story.x: *   No binary blobs — no proprietary code or binaries in the boot process.
story.z: * 无二进制 blob — 启动过程中没有专有代码或二进制文件。

story.x: *   No vendor-locked BSP — free from outdated vendor board support packages.
story.z: * 无供应商锁定的 BSP — 不受过时的供应商板支持包的影响。

story.x: Our goal is to create a fully upstream-supported ARM computer that never becomes outdated, along with a well-documented platform giving the community maximum freedom to customize. To pull this off, we've [partnered with the Collabora team](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html), well-known contributors to the Linux kernel.
story.z: 我们的目标是创建一款完全受上游支持且永不过时的 ARM 计算机，以及一个文档齐全的平台，为社区提供最大程度的定制自由。为了实现这一目标，我们与 Collabora 团队合作，他们是 Linux 内核的知名贡献者。

story.x: *   Layer 0 (Zero) — Offline point-to-point access-control protocols: NFC, low-frequency RFID, Sub-1 GHz radio, Infrared, wired protocols like iButton, UART, SPI, I2C. Based on a low-power microcontroller.
story.z: * 第 0 层（零）— 离线点对点访问控制协议：NFC、低频 RFID、Sub-1 GHz 无线电、红外、有线协议，如 iButton、UART、SPI、I2C。基于低功耗微控制器。

story.x: *   Layer 1 (One) — Everything that's IP-connected: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, 5G, and satellite. It's all about networking, data transfer, and high-performance computing. An open Linux toolkit running on powerful hardware, enough computing power to handle SDR and local AI.
story.z: * 第 1 层（一）- IP 连接的一切：Wi-Fi、以太网、5G 和卫星。这一切都与网络、数据传输和高性能计算有关。一个开放的Linux工具包，运行在强大的硬件上，有足够的计算能力来处理SDR和本地AI。

story.x: So they're not "newer" and "older" generations of the same product. Flipper One doesn't replace Flipper Zero — they're different categories of devices. Comparing them directly would be like comparing a hammer to a screwdriver.
story.z: 因此它们不是同一产品的“新”和“旧”代。 Flipper One 不会取代 Flipper Zero——它们是不同类别的设备。直接比较它们就像将锤子与螺丝刀进行比较一样。

story.x: *   Low-power MCU (Raspberry Pi RP2350) — manages LCD display, buttons, power and controls system boot stages.
story.z: * 低功耗 MCU (Raspberry Pi RP2350) — 管理 LCD 显示屏、按钮、电源并控制系统启动阶段。

story.x: *   High-performance CPU (Rockchip RK3576) — runs Linux kernel and user apps, and manages high-speed peripheral interfaces: Ethernet, Wi-Fi, PCIe, USB, HDMI, etc.
story.z: * 高性能 CPU (Rockchip RK3576) — 运行 Linux 内核和用户应用程序，并管理高速外围接口：以太网、Wi-Fi、PCIe、USB、HDMI 等。

story.x: The idea behind the [2-processor architecture](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture) is to make Flipper One a fully standalone device that remains operational even if the user completely breaks the Linux system. It allows to recover OS without needing an external computer or additional software.
story.z: [2 处理器架构](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture) 背后的想法是使 Flipper One 成为一款完全独立的设备，即使用户完全破坏 Linux 系统也能保持运行。它允许恢复操作系统，而无需外部计算机或其他软件。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to a laptop with a single USB-C cable to get SSH console access and charge the device at the same time. No extra adapters are needed for Linux console access or power — Flipper One can simultaneously emulate a USB network adapter, a serial (COM port), or disk device.![Image 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)
story.z: 使用一根 USB-C 电缆将 Flipper One 连接到笔记本电脑，以访问 SSH 控制台并同时为设备充电。 Linux 控制台访问或电源不需要额外的适配器 - Flipper One 可以同时模拟 USB 网络适配器、串行（COM 端口）或磁盘设备。！[图片8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scal e-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)

story.x: *   Power IN/OUT — the USB-C1 port supports 5–20 V Power Delivery and can charge Flipper One or power your laptop.
story.z: * 电源输入/输出 — USB-C1 端口支持 5–20 V 供电，可为 Flipper One 充电或为笔记本电脑供电。

story.x: *   Device Emulation — the same port also emulates a USB network adapter, serial device, or disk drive. All at speeds of up to 5 Gbps.
story.z: * 设备仿真 — 同一端口还可以仿真 USB 网络适配器、串行设备或磁盘驱动器。全部速度高达 5 Gbps。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to an external display using a single USB Type-C cable and get a full desktop experience. ![Image 9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)
story.z: 使用一根 USB Type-C 电缆将 Flipper One 连接到外部显示器，并获得完整的桌面体验。 ![图片9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=sc ale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)

story.x: *   USB DisplayPort Alt Mode — video output at 4K@120Hz to an external display over a single USB-C cable.
story.z: * USB DisplayPort Alt 模式 — 通过单根 USB-C 电缆以 4K@120Hz 的视频输出到外部显示器。

story.x: *   USB Host + Charging — connect peripherals such as a keyboard and mouse through your monitor’s USB hub while charging Flipper One over the same cable.
story.z: * USB 主机 + 充电 — 通过显示器的 USB 集线器连接键盘和鼠标等外围设备，同时通过同一根电缆为 Flipper One 充电。

story.x: We wanted to make alternative firmware development for Flipper One easier. You can debug and perform a full system recovery through the same primary USB-C port (USB-C1). For most development tasks, you won't need a separate debugger.
story.z: 我们希望让 Flipper One 的替代固件开发变得更加容易。您可以通过同一主 USB-C 端口 (USB-C1) 调试并执行完整系统恢复。对于大多数开发任务，您不需要单独的调试器。

story.x: Using the USB-C1 port, you can access the debug console & BOOTSEL mode for recovering the RP2350 MCU, and MaskROM mode for recovering the RK3576 CPU.
story.z: 使用USB-C1端口，您可以访问调试控制台和BOOTSEL模式以恢复RP2350 MCU，以及MaskROM模式以恢复RK3576 CPU。

story.x: *   2× Gigabit Ethernet— two independent WAN/LAN ports, each running at 1 Gbps. Can be used for a transparent bridge, MitM sniffing, and more.
story.z: * 2 个千兆位以太网 — 两个独立的 WAN/LAN 端口，每个端口以 1 Gbps 运行。可用于透明桥、MitM 嗅探等。

story.x: *   Wi-Fi 6E— based on the MT7921AUN chipset with monitor mode support. Covers 2.4/5/6 GHz bands and can run as both a Wi-Fi Client (STA) and a Hotspot (AP).
story.z: * Wi-Fi 6E — 基于 MT7921AUN 芯片组，支持监控模式。覆盖 2.4/5/6 GHz 频段，可作为 Wi-Fi 客户端 (STA) 和热点 (AP) 运行。

story.x: *   Cellular modem— 5G or LTE modem via the M.2 expansion module, with support for external antennas. Accepts a physical Nano SIM (4FF) and eSIM.
story.z: * 蜂窝调制解调器 — 通过 M.2 扩展模块的 5G 或 LTE 调制解调器，支持外部天线。接受物理 Nano SIM (4FF) 和 eSIM。

story.x: *   USB Ethernet— up to 5 Gbps emulated over USB-C. Connect your laptop or smartphone via a USB cable to add an extra network interface. Works via USB CDC-NCM, so no drivers are required.
story.z: * USB 以太网 — 通过 USB-C 模拟高达 5 Gbps。通过 USB 电缆连接笔记本电脑或智能手机以添加额外的网络接口。通过 USB CDC-NCM 工作，因此无需驱动程序。

story.x: Out of the box, Flipper One can work as a gateway to any network, a multi-hotspot bridge, an inline Ethernet sniffer, a USB Wi-Fi/Ethernet adapter for a PC or phone.
story.z: Flipper One 开箱即用，可以用作任何网络的网关、多热点桥接器、内联以太网嗅探器、PC 或手机的 USB Wi-Fi/以太网适配器。

story.x: Analyze wired and wireless IP networks: discover active hosts, scan for open ports and services, detect network attacks and report anomalies. Flipper One comes with built-in apps for network analysis, mapping network topology, and detecting host misconfigurations.![Image 13](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/901/978/c2894be981d98c00ee8d0a063b05ceb1_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794772894&width=1360&sig=b8%2BQACZj70PNfVrKKT0uzYmMNTfFCY8OEM1kvDS5CGM%3D)It can also identify vulnerable and outdated services, act as a honeypot to detect network scanning activity, and save the results as exportable reports.
story.z: 分析有线和无线 IP 网络：发现活动主机、扫描开放端口和服务、检测网络攻击并报告异常情况。 Flipper One 附带用于网络分析、映射网络拓扑和检测主机错误配置的内置应用程序。！[图片13](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/901/978/c2894be981d98c00ee8d0a063b05ceb1_original.jpg?fit=sca le-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794772894&width=1360&sig=b8%2BQACZj70PNfVrKKT0uzYmMNTfFCY8OEM1kvDS5CGM%3D)It还可以识别易受攻击和过时的服务，充当蜜罐来检测网络扫描活动，并将结果保存为可导出的报告。

story.x: Interface is a ring with one button: press it, talk, and your words become a note, a message or a request to your AI agents, without taking out your phone. It works with NatureOS on iPhone and Android, and with your Mac or Windows computer.
story.z: 界面是一个带有一个按钮的戒指：按下它，说话，你的话语就会变成一条笔记、一条消息或对你的人工智能代理的请求，而无需拿出你的手机。它可与 iPhone 和 Android 上的 NatureOS 以及 Mac 或 Windows 计算机配合使用。

story.x: Without a Membership, Interface tracks your health and records your notes as audio. Every recording is sent automatically, as an audio file, to the AI you already use, through a webhook.
story.z: 如果没有会员资格，Interface 会跟踪您的健康状况并将您的笔记记录为音频。每个录音都会通过 Webhook 以音频文件的形式自动发送到您已经使用的 AI。

story.x: Membership ($9/month) adds our built-in AI: fast and accurate transcripts in 90+ languages, meeting recaps, dictation into any app, insights on your health, and a ready-to-use infrastructure for connecting multiple AI agents to your Interface. 3 to 6 months are included with your reward. If you stop, your ring keeps working with your own AI via webhook, and everything you recorded and transcribed stays yours.
story.z: 会员资格（9 美元/月）增加了我们的内置人工智能：90 多种语言的快速准确的文字记录、会议回顾、对任何应用程序的听写、对您健康状况的见解以及用于将多个人工智能代理连接到您的界面的即用型基础设施。您的奖励包含 3 至 6 个月。如果您停止，您的戒指将继续通过 webhook 与您自己的 AI 配合工作，并且您记录和转录的所有内容都属于您。

story.x: Whisper in a waiting room, or speak up at a concert. When it's very quiet or very loud, bring the ring close to your lips. The rest of the time, just talk with your hand wherever it is.
story.z: 在候诊室里窃窃私语，或者在音乐会上发言。当环境非常安静或非常吵闹时，将戒指靠近嘴唇。其余时间，无论手在哪里，都可以用手说话。

story.x: Interface reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, sleep, skin temperature and activity, day and night. Log what you eat, your workouts, your supplements and how you feel, and your AI pairs it with your biometrics to give you insights made for you.
story.z: 界面可读取您白天和晚上的心率、HRV、血氧、睡眠、皮肤温度和活动。记录您的饮食、锻炼、补充品以及您的感受，您的人工智能将其与您的生物识别数据配对，为您提供量身定制的见解。

story.x: Your agents use your apps for you. Ask, and the agent you chose does the work. Anything that matters waits for your approval, and in NatureOS you choose which apps each agent can use.
story.z: 您的代理为您使用您的应用程序。询问后，您选择的代理就会帮您完成这项工作。任何重要的事情都等待您的批准，在 NatureOS 中您可以选择每个代理可以使用哪些应用程序。

story.x: Catch a thought before it's gone. Dictate an idea, a reminder or a name, and find it later in NatureOS, or let your agents organize it for you.
story.z: 在一个想法消失之前抓住它。口述一个想法、一个提醒或一个名称，然后在 NatureOS 中找到它，或者让您的代理为您组织它。

story.x: Record a meeting and get the full transcript, who said what, and a recap with decisions and next steps. Later, just ask what you decided. The light on the ring shows when it's recording.
story.z: 记录会议并获取完整的记录、谁说了什么，以及决策和后续步骤的回顾。稍后，问问你的决定。录音时，环上的灯会显示。

story.x: Talk to your agents through HumanPods while your phone stays in your pocket. Ask a question, start a task or hear an update. With Interface, press the ring and ask, and hear the reply in your HumanPods.
story.z: 当您的手机放在口袋里时，即可通过 HumanPods 与您的客服人员交谈。提出问题、开始任务或听取更新。通过 Interface，按响铃并询问，然后在 HumanPods 中听到答复。

story.x: All of this lives in one ring of stainless steel, brushed, with polished edges, made to be worn every day.
story.z: 所有这些都集中在一枚不锈钢戒指上，经过拉丝处理，边缘抛光，适合每天佩戴。

story.x: Hold a key and talk, and clean text lands in any app on your Mac or PC. Double-tap, and your meeting turns into a transcript, a summary and next steps. The other keys do whatever you set them to: open an app, fire a shortcut, or run a whole routine.

story.x: Flipper One runs on completely open-source Linux firmware with a mainline kernel. This means full compatibility with the latest kernel versions:
story.z: Flipper One 在带有主线内核的完全开源 Linux 固件上运行。这意味着与最新内核版本完全兼容：

story.x: *   Mainline Linux kernel support — full support in upstream Linux kernel.
story.z: * 主线 Linux 内核支持 — 上游 Linux 内核的完全支持。

story.x: *   No binary blobs — no proprietary code or binaries in the boot process.
story.z: * 无二进制 blob — 启动过程中没有专有代码或二进制文件。

story.x: *   No vendor-locked BSP — free from outdated vendor board support packages.
story.z: * 无供应商锁定的 BSP — 不受过时的供应商板支持包的影响。

story.x: Our goal is to create a fully upstream-supported ARM computer that never becomes outdated, along with a well-documented platform giving the community maximum freedom to customize. To pull this off, we've [partnered with the Collabora team](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html), well-known contributors to the Linux kernel.
story.z: 我们的目标是创建一款完全受上游支持且永不过时的 ARM 计算机，以及一个文档齐全的平台，为社区提供最大程度的定制自由。为了实现这一目标，我们与 Collabora 团队合作，他们是 Linux 内核的知名贡献者。

story.x: *   Layer 0 (Zero) — Offline point-to-point access-control protocols: NFC, low-frequency RFID, Sub-1 GHz radio, Infrared, wired protocols like iButton, UART, SPI, I2C. Based on a low-power microcontroller.
story.z: * 第 0 层（零）— 离线点对点访问控制协议：NFC、低频 RFID、Sub-1 GHz 无线电、红外、有线协议，如 iButton、UART、SPI、I2C。基于低功耗微控制器。

story.x: *   Layer 1 (One) — Everything that's IP-connected: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, 5G, and satellite. It's all about networking, data transfer, and high-performance computing. An open Linux toolkit running on powerful hardware, enough computing power to handle SDR and local AI.
story.z: * 第 1 层（一）- IP 连接的一切：Wi-Fi、以太网、5G 和卫星。这一切都与网络、数据传输和高性能计算有关。一个开放的Linux工具包，运行在强大的硬件上，有足够的计算能力来处理SDR和本地AI。

story.x: So they're not "newer" and "older" generations of the same product. Flipper One doesn't replace Flipper Zero — they're different categories of devices. Comparing them directly would be like comparing a hammer to a screwdriver.
story.z: 因此它们不是同一产品的“新”和“旧”代。 Flipper One 不会取代 Flipper Zero——它们是不同类别的设备。直接比较它们就像将锤子与螺丝刀进行比较一样。

story.x: *   Low-power MCU (Raspberry Pi RP2350) — manages LCD display, buttons, power and controls system boot stages.
story.z: * 低功耗 MCU (Raspberry Pi RP2350) — 管理 LCD 显示屏、按钮、电源并控制系统启动阶段。

story.x: *   High-performance CPU (Rockchip RK3576) — runs Linux kernel and user apps, and manages high-speed peripheral interfaces: Ethernet, Wi-Fi, PCIe, USB, HDMI, etc.
story.z: * 高性能 CPU (Rockchip RK3576) — 运行 Linux 内核和用户应用程序，并管理高速外围接口：以太网、Wi-Fi、PCIe、USB、HDMI 等。

story.x: The idea behind the [2-processor architecture](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture) is to make Flipper One a fully standalone device that remains operational even if the user completely breaks the Linux system. It allows to recover OS without needing an external computer or additional software.
story.z: [2 处理器架构](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture) 背后的想法是使 Flipper One 成为一款完全独立的设备，即使用户完全破坏 Linux 系统也能保持运行。它允许恢复操作系统，而无需外部计算机或其他软件。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to a laptop with a single USB-C cable to get SSH console access and charge the device at the same time. No extra adapters are needed for Linux console access or power — Flipper One can simultaneously emulate a USB network adapter, a serial (COM port), or disk device.![Image 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)
story.z: 使用一根 USB-C 电缆将 Flipper One 连接到笔记本电脑，以访问 SSH 控制台并同时为设备充电。 Linux 控制台访问或电源不需要额外的适配器 - Flipper One 可以同时模拟 USB 网络适配器、串行（COM 端口）或磁盘设备。！[图片8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scal e-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)

story.x: *   Power IN/OUT — the USB-C1 port supports 5–20 V Power Delivery and can charge Flipper One or power your laptop.
story.z: * 电源输入/输出 — USB-C1 端口支持 5–20 V 供电，可为 Flipper One 充电或为笔记本电脑供电。

story.x: *   Device Emulation — the same port also emulates a USB network adapter, serial device, or disk drive. All at speeds of up to 5 Gbps.
story.z: * 设备仿真 — 同一端口还可以仿真 USB 网络适配器、串行设备或磁盘驱动器。全部速度高达 5 Gbps。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to an external display using a single USB Type-C cable and get a full desktop experience. ![Image 9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)
story.z: 使用一根 USB Type-C 电缆将 Flipper One 连接到外部显示器，并获得完整的桌面体验。 ![图片9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=sc ale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)

story.x: *   USB DisplayPort Alt Mode — video output at 4K@120Hz to an external display over a single USB-C cable.
story.z: * USB DisplayPort Alt 模式 — 通过单根 USB-C 电缆以 4K@120Hz 的视频输出到外部显示器。

story.x: *   USB Host + Charging — connect peripherals such as a keyboard and mouse through your monitor’s USB hub while charging Flipper One over the same cable.
story.z: * USB 主机 + 充电 — 通过显示器的 USB 集线器连接键盘和鼠标等外围设备，同时通过同一根电缆为 Flipper One 充电。

story.x: We wanted to make alternative firmware development for Flipper One easier. You can debug and perform a full system recovery through the same primary USB-C port (USB-C1). For most development tasks, you won't need a separate debugger.
story.z: 我们希望让 Flipper One 的替代固件开发变得更加容易。您可以通过同一主 USB-C 端口 (USB-C1) 调试并执行完整系统恢复。对于大多数开发任务，您不需要单独的调试器。

story.x: Using the USB-C1 port, you can access the debug console & BOOTSEL mode for recovering the RP2350 MCU, and MaskROM mode for recovering the RK3576 CPU.
story.z: 使用USB-C1端口，您可以访问调试控制台和BOOTSEL模式以恢复RP2350 MCU，以及MaskROM模式以恢复RK3576 CPU。

story.x: *   2× Gigabit Ethernet— two independent WAN/LAN ports, each running at 1 Gbps. Can be used for a transparent bridge, MitM sniffing, and more.
story.z: * 2 个千兆位以太网 — 两个独立的 WAN/LAN 端口，每个端口以 1 Gbps 运行。可用于透明桥、MitM 嗅探等。

story.x: *   Wi-Fi 6E— based on the MT7921AUN chipset with monitor mode support. Covers 2.4/5/6 GHz bands and can run as both a Wi-Fi Client (STA) and a Hotspot (AP).
story.z: * Wi-Fi 6E — 基于 MT7921AUN 芯片组，支持监控模式。覆盖 2.4/5/6 GHz 频段，可作为 Wi-Fi 客户端 (STA) 和热点 (AP) 运行。

story.x: *   Cellular modem— 5G or LTE modem via the M.2 expansion module, with support for external antennas. Accepts a physical Nano SIM (4FF) and eSIM.
story.z: * 蜂窝调制解调器 — 通过 M.2 扩展模块的 5G 或 LTE 调制解调器，支持外部天线。接受物理 Nano SIM (4FF) 和 eSIM。

story.x: *   USB Ethernet— up to 5 Gbps emulated over USB-C. Connect your laptop or smartphone via a USB cable to add an extra network interface. Works via USB CDC-NCM, so no drivers are required.
story.z: * USB 以太网 — 通过 USB-C 模拟高达 5 Gbps。通过 USB 电缆连接笔记本电脑或智能手机以添加额外的网络接口。通过 USB CDC-NCM 工作，因此无需驱动程序。

story.x: Out of the box, Flipper One can work as a gateway to any network, a multi-hotspot bridge, an inline Ethernet sniffer, a USB Wi-Fi/Ethernet adapter for a PC or phone.
story.z: Flipper One 开箱即用，可以用作任何网络的网关、多热点桥接器、内联以太网嗅探器、PC 或手机的 USB Wi-Fi/以太网适配器。

story.x: Analyze wired and wireless IP networks: discover active hosts, scan for open ports and services, detect network attacks and report anomalies. Flipper One comes with built-in apps for network analysis, mapping network topology, and detecting host misconfigurations.![Image 13](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/901/978/c2894be981d98c00ee8d0a063b05ceb1_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794772894&width=1360&sig=b8%2BQACZj70PNfVrKKT0uzYmMNTfFCY8OEM1kvDS5CGM%3D)It can also identify vulnerable and outdated services, act as a honeypot to detect network scanning activity, and save the results as exportable reports.
story.z: 分析有线和无线 IP 网络：发现活动主机、扫描开放端口和服务、检测网络攻击并报告异常情况。 Flipper One 附带用于网络分析、映射网络拓扑和检测主机错误配置的内置应用程序。！[图片13](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/901/978/c2894be981d98c00ee8d0a063b05ceb1_original.jpg?fit=sca le-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794772894&width=1360&sig=b8%2BQACZj70PNfVrKKT0uzYmMNTfFCY8OEM1kvDS5CGM%3D)It还可以识别易受攻击和过时的服务，充当蜜罐来检测网络扫描活动，并将结果保存为可导出的报告。

story.x: Interface is a ring with one button: press it, talk, and your words become a note, a message or a request to your AI agents, without taking out your phone. It works with NatureOS on iPhone and Android, and with your Mac or Windows computer.
story.z: 界面是一个带有一个按钮的戒指：按下它，说话，你的话语就会变成一条笔记、一条消息或对你的人工智能代理的请求，而无需拿出你的手机。它可与 iPhone 和 Android 上的 NatureOS 以及 Mac 或 Windows 计算机配合使用。

story.x: Without a Membership, Interface tracks your health and records your notes as audio. Every recording is sent automatically, as an audio file, to the AI you already use, through a webhook.
story.z: 如果没有会员资格，Interface 会跟踪您的健康状况并将您的笔记记录为音频。每个录音都会通过 Webhook 以音频文件的形式自动发送到您已经使用的 AI。

story.x: Membership ($9/month) adds our built-in AI: fast and accurate transcripts in 90+ languages, meeting recaps, dictation into any app, insights on your health, and a ready-to-use infrastructure for connecting multiple AI agents to your Interface. 3 to 6 months are included with your reward. If you stop, your ring keeps working with your own AI via webhook, and everything you recorded and transcribed stays yours.
story.z: 会员资格（9 美元/月）增加了我们的内置人工智能：90 多种语言的快速准确的文字记录、会议回顾、对任何应用程序的听写、对您健康状况的见解以及用于将多个人工智能代理连接到您的界面的即用型基础设施。您的奖励包含 3 至 6 个月。如果您停止，您的戒指将继续通过 webhook 与您自己的 AI 配合工作，并且您记录和转录的所有内容都属于您。

story.x: Whisper in a waiting room, or speak up at a concert. When it's very quiet or very loud, bring the ring close to your lips. The rest of the time, just talk with your hand wherever it is.
story.z: 在候诊室里窃窃私语，或者在音乐会上发言。当环境非常安静或非常吵闹时，将戒指靠近嘴唇。其余时间，无论手在哪里，都可以用手说话。

story.x: Interface reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, sleep, skin temperature and activity, day and night. Log what you eat, your workouts, your supplements and how you feel, and your AI pairs it with your biometrics to give you insights made for you.
story.z: 界面可读取您白天和晚上的心率、HRV、血氧、睡眠、皮肤温度和活动。记录您的饮食、锻炼、补充品以及您的感受，您的人工智能将其与您的生物识别数据配对，为您提供量身定制的见解。

story.x: Your agents use your apps for you. Ask, and the agent you chose does the work. Anything that matters waits for your approval, and in NatureOS you choose which apps each agent can use.
story.z: 您的代理为您使用您的应用程序。询问后，您选择的代理就会帮您完成这项工作。任何重要的事情都等待您的批准，在 NatureOS 中您可以选择每个代理可以使用哪些应用程序。

story.x: Catch a thought before it's gone. Dictate an idea, a reminder or a name, and find it later in NatureOS, or let your agents organize it for you.
story.z: 在一个想法消失之前抓住它。口述一个想法、一个提醒或一个名称，然后在 NatureOS 中找到它，或者让您的代理为您组织它。

story.x: Record a meeting and get the full transcript, who said what, and a recap with decisions and next steps. Later, just ask what you decided. The light on the ring shows when it's recording.
story.z: 记录会议并获取完整的记录、谁说了什么，以及决策和后续步骤的回顾。稍后，问问你的决定。录音时，环上的灯会显示。

story.x: Talk to your agents through HumanPods while your phone stays in your pocket. Ask a question, start a task or hear an update. With Interface, press the ring and ask, and hear the reply in your HumanPods.
story.z: 当您的手机放在口袋里时，即可通过 HumanPods 与您的客服人员交谈。提出问题、开始任务或听取更新。通过 Interface，按响铃并询问，然后在 HumanPods 中听到答复。

story.x: All of this lives in one ring of stainless steel, brushed, with polished edges, made to be worn every day.
story.z: 所有这些都集中在一枚不锈钢戒指上，经过拉丝处理，边缘抛光，适合每天佩戴。

story.x: Worn on your index finger, with the button facing your thumb. Waterproof.

story.x: Great Espresso, Made Easier
story.z: 优质浓缩咖啡，变得更简单

story.x: Portable espresso makers offer convenience, but often sacrifice control and consistency. Professional machines deliver both, but are bulky, complex, and tied to an outlet. You shouldn’t have to choose.
story.z: 便携式浓缩咖啡机提供了便利，但通常会牺牲控制和一致性。专业机器可以同时提供这两种功能，但体积庞大、复杂，并且与插座相连。你不应该选择。

story.x: After months of tuning and testing guided by coffee champion Simon Gautherin, MAX ESPRESSO makes professional espresso portable and simple.
story.z: 经过咖啡冠军 Simon Gautherin 指导下数月的调整和测试，MAX ESPRESSO 使专业浓缩咖啡变得便携而简单。

story.x: Some days call for freshly ground coffee. Others call for speed.
story.z: 有时需要现磨咖啡。其他人则呼吁速度。

story.x: MAX ESPRESSO brings a 51mm basket, Nespresso Original, and Dolce Gusto into one portable system—so the coffee fits the moment, not the other way around.
story.z: MAX ESPRESSO 将 51 毫米篮子、Nespresso Original 和 Dolce Gusto 整合到一个便携式系统中，因此咖啡适合当下，而不是相反。

story.x: At just 22 oz, it integrates self-heating, high-pressure extraction, and independent power—no outlet or fixed coffee setup required.
story.z: 它的重量仅为 22 盎司，集成了自加热、高压萃取和独立电源，无需插座或固定咖啡装置。

story.x: Launch backers get the Modular Coffee Carry System: a leather travel case, portable stand, dosing ring, tamper, and scoop—each part in its place.
story.z: 启动支持者获得模块化咖啡携带系统：皮革旅行箱、便携式支架、剂量环、搅拌棒和勺子——每个部件都就位。

story.x: Developed with coffee competition champion Simon Gautherin, EquaFlow™ coordinates the coffee-to-water ratio, coffee bed, pressure, and temperature as one extraction logic—so balance is built into every brew, not left to chance.
story.z: EquaFlow™ 与咖啡竞赛冠军 Simon Gautherin 共同开发，将咖啡与水的比例、咖啡床、压力和温度协调为一个提取逻辑，因此每次冲泡都内置平衡，而不是偶然。

story.x: The 51mm commercial-grade basket creates a thinner, more even coffee bed while holding 2× the capacity of a small basket—enough for a Double Espresso in one pull.
story.z: 51 毫米商业级篮子可打造更薄、更均匀的咖啡床，同时容纳 2 倍小篮子的容量 — 足以一次拉出双份浓缩咖啡。

story.x: 24 bar pressure and a stable 92°C (198°F), brew temperature fully saturate the coffee bed for rich, consistent crema
story.z: 24 巴压力和稳定的 92°C (198°F) 冲泡温度使咖啡床完全饱和，产生丰富、一致的咖啡油脂

story.x: One Touch Away
story.z: 一触即达

story.x: Thousands of hours of Champion tuning are built into the brew program. One touch starts automatic heating and extraction, so even beginners can recreate the champion’s espresso.
story.z: 冲泡程序中内置了数千小时的 Champion 调整。一键启动自动加热和萃取，因此即使是初学者也能重现冠军的浓缩咖啡。

story.x: Easy to Identify
story.z: 易于识别

story.x: From dosing to tamping and brewing, the full accessory set keeps the fresh-ground workflow together. Color-matched components make the right tool obvious at a glance.
story.z: 从配料到压实和酿造，全套配件将新鲜研磨的工作流程保持在一起。颜色匹配的组件使正确的工具一目了然。

story.x: Pair MAX ESPRESSO with its purpose-built MAX Grinder for a complete bean-to-espresso experience. Grind fresh, brew, and enjoy—at home or on the go.
story.z: 将 MAX ESPRESSO 与其专用的 MAX 研磨机搭配使用，以获得完整的咖啡豆到浓缩咖啡体验。新鲜研磨、冲泡并享用——在家或在旅途中。

story.x: Custom-designed to carry MAX ESPRESSO and MAX GRINDER together, our travel case keeps your complete bean-to-espresso setup in one place—ready to take along
story.z: 我们的旅行箱经过定制设计，可将 MAX ESPRESSO 和 MAX GRINDER 一起携带，将您从咖啡豆到浓缩咖啡的完整设置放在一个地方，随时可以随身携带

story.x: EquaFlow™ works with freshly ground coffee to bring out fuller aroma, sweetness, and depth. Compatible with Nespresso Original and Dolce Gusto capsules. No grinding or weighing—just insert and brew.
story.z: EquaFlow™ 与现磨咖啡配合，带来更浓郁的香气、甜味和深度。与 Nespresso Original 和 Dolce Gusto 胶囊兼容。无需研磨或称重——只需插入并冲泡即可。

story.x: Coffee Without Limits
story.z: 咖啡无极限

story.x: Ready Either Way
story.z: 准备就绪

story.x: Powered by a 7800mAh battery, it self-heats about 5 cups from cold water; with hot water, direct extraction reaches 500+ cups

story.x: Built to Travel
story.z: 为旅行而生

story.x: A lightweight protective shell and Tritan food-contact components balance durability, safety, and easy carry.
story.z: 轻质保护壳和 Tritan 食品接触组件平衡了耐用性、安全性和方便携带。

story.x: Ready to Scale
story.z: 准备扩展

story.x: From product engineering and extraction control to system integration, MAX ESPRESSO was developed in-house as one complete system. With real-world testing and final validation complete, mass production comes next.
story.z: 从产品工程和提取控制到系统集成，MAX ESPRESSO 都是内部开发的一个完整的系统。随着实际测试和最终验证的完成，接下来就是大规模生产。

story.x: Before launch, we invited professional baristas, coffee enthusiasts, campers, road-trippers, frequent travelers, and everyday commuters to put MAX ESPRESSO through real-life use. Their feedback helped us improve the details that shape everyday use: the brewing workflow, portability, handling, cleanup, and overall experience.
story.z: 在推出之前，我们邀请了专业咖啡师、咖啡爱好者、露营者、公路旅行者、常旅客和日常通勤者来实际使用 MAX ESPRESSO。他们的反馈帮助我们改进了影响日常使用的细节：酿造工作流程、便携性、操作、清洁和整体体验。

story.x: SecondBrain VoicePad is a five-key AI gadget for your desk.

story.x: Hold a key and talk, and clean text lands in any app on your Mac or PC. Double-tap, and your meeting turns into a transcript, a summary and next steps. The other keys do whatever you set them to: open an app, fire a shortcut, or run a whole routine.
story.z: 按住按键并讲话，干净的文本就会出现在 Mac 或 PC 上的任何应用程序中。双击，您的会议就会变成文字记录、摘要和后续步骤。其他键可以执行您设置的任何操作：打开应用程序、启动快捷方式或运行整个例程。

story.x: Emails, Slack replies, prompts for ChatGPT and Claude, notes to yourself. Most of what you type, you could just say. Hold the wide key, talk, and let go. VoicePad types it wherever your cursor is.
story.z: 电子邮件、Slack 回复、ChatGPT 和 Claude 提示、给自己的笔记。您输入的大部分内容都可以直接说出来。按住宽键，说话，然后放开。无论光标在哪里，VoicePad 都会输入它。

story.x: You don't have to talk like you're reading a script. VoicePad drops the ums, the repeats and the false starts, and keeps what you meant. Voice typing is unlimited in your first year, then 4,000 words a week, free.
story.z: 你不必像在读剧本一样说话。 VoicePad 去掉了“嗯”、重复和错误的开头，并保留了您的意思。第一年语音输入不受限制，之后每周免费输入 4,000 个单词。

story.x: Made for open offices. The two mics sit right at your mouth, not across the desk in your laptop, so a quiet voice still gets every word.
story.z: 专为开放式办公室而设计。两个麦克风就位于您的嘴边，而不是放在笔记本电脑的桌子对面，因此您仍然可以用安静的声音听到每个字。

story.x: Give any key its own way of speaking. Translate to English takes any of 50+ languages. Professional Rewrite polishes what you said. Terminal Helper turns a request into a command. Screen Dictation reads what's on your screen, so names and terms come out right.
story.z: 让任何按键都有自己的表达方式。翻译成英语需要 50 多种语言中的任何一种。专业重写润色您所说的内容。终端助手将请求转换为命令。屏幕听写会读取屏幕上的内容，因此名称和术语会正确显示。

story.x: Double-tap to start. Double-tap to stop.
story.z: 双击即可开始。双击即可停止。

story.x: VoicePad records the meeting in the room or on a call, even without your computer, then hands you the transcript, a summary and the next steps.
story.z: 即使没有计算机，VoicePad 也会在房间或通话中记录会议，然后向您提供文字记录、摘要和后续步骤。

story.x: Every key does what you tell it. Set them up in the free Genspark Super App for Mac and Windows, and choose whether each one works with a tap, a double-tap or a hold.
story.z: 每个键都会按照您的指示执行操作。在适用于 Mac 和 Windows 的免费 G​​enspark Super 应用程序中进行设置，并选择每一项是通过点击、双击还是按住来工作。

story.x: A few examples. Hands-free Mode, Live translation and screen recording are among the voice actions. Spotlight, Mission Control and lock screen are among the shortcuts. And on macOS, a key can run a command inside an app, like Raise hand in Teams, a new tab in your browser, or your unread messages in Slack.
story.z: 举几个例子。语音操作包括免提模式、实时翻译和屏幕录制。快捷方式包括聚光灯、任务控制和锁定屏幕。在 macOS 上，按键可以在应用程序内运行命令，例如 Teams 中的“举手”、浏览器中的新选项卡或 Slack 中的未读消息。

story.x: Smart Action is a routine on one key. Pick the press, line up the steps, and voice steps can even follow your own custom instructions. Three to start with:
story.z: 智能操作是一键例行程序。选择压力机、排列步骤，语音步骤甚至可以遵循您自己的自定义指令。从三个开始：

story.x: • Stand-up update. Open Slack › type “Stand-up:” › Professional Rewrite › press Return.

story.x: Flipper One runs on completely open-source Linux firmware with a mainline kernel. This means full compatibility with the latest kernel versions:
story.z: Flipper One 运行于完全开源的 Linux 固件之上，采用主线内核。这意味着与最新内核版本完全兼容：

story.x: *   Mainline Linux kernel support — full support in upstream Linux kernel.
story.z: * 主线 Linux 内核支持 — 在上游 Linux 内核中提供全面支持。

story.x: *   No binary blobs — no proprietary code or binaries in the boot process.
story.z: * 无二进制 Blob — 启动过程中没有专有代码或二进制文件。

story.x: *   No vendor-locked BSP — free from outdated vendor board support packages.
story.z: * 无供应商锁定 BSP — 无需使用过时的供应商板级支持包。

story.x: Our goal is to create a fully upstream-supported ARM computer that never becomes outdated, along with a well-documented platform giving the community maximum freedom to customize. To pull this off, we've [partnered with the Collabora team](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html), well-known contributors to the Linux kernel.
story.z: 我们的目标是打造一款完全由上游支持的 ARM 电脑，它永远不会过时，同时提供一个文档齐全的平台，让社区拥有最大的定制自由。为了实现这一目标，我们[与 Collabora 团队](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html)建立了合作关系，他们是 Linux 内核的知名贡献者。

story.x: *   Layer 0 (Zero) — Offline point-to-point access-control protocols: NFC, low-frequency RFID, Sub-1 GHz radio, Infrared, wired protocols like iButton, UART, SPI, I2C. Based on a low-power microcontroller.
story.z: *第0层（零层）— 离线点对点访问控制协议：NFC、低频RFID、Sub-1 GHz无线电、红外、有线协议（如iButton、UART、SPI、I2C）。基于低功耗微控制器。

story.x: *   Layer 1 (One) — Everything that's IP-connected: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, 5G, and satellite. It's all about networking, data transfer, and high-performance computing. An open Linux toolkit running on powerful hardware, enough computing power to handle SDR and local AI.
story.z: *第1层（一层）—所有通过IP连接的设备：Wi-Fi、以太网、5G和卫星。这完全与联网、数据传输和高性能计算有关。一个在强大硬件上运行的开放式Linux工具包，具有足够的算力来处理SDR和本地AI。

story.x: So they're not "newer" and "older" generations of the same product. Flipper One doesn't replace Flipper Zero — they're different categories of devices. Comparing them directly would be like comparing a hammer to a screwdriver.
story.z: 因此，它们并不是同一款产品的“更新”和“更旧”的代次。Flipper One 并不取代 Flipper Zero，它们属于不同类别的设备。直接比较它们就像拿锤子和螺丝刀作比较。

story.x: *   Low-power MCU (Raspberry Pi RP2350) — manages LCD display, buttons, power and controls system boot stages.
story.z: * 低功耗 MCU（Raspberry Pi RP2350）— 管理液晶显示屏、按钮、电源并控制系统启动阶段。

story.x: *   High-performance CPU (Rockchip RK3576) — runs Linux kernel and user apps, and manages high-speed peripheral interfaces: Ethernet, Wi-Fi, PCIe, USB, HDMI, etc.
story.z: * 高性能 CPU（Rockchip RK3576）——运行 Linux 内核和用户应用程序，并管理高速外设接口：以太网、Wi-Fi、PCIe、USB、HDMI 等。

story.x: The idea behind the [2-processor architecture](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture) is to make Flipper One a fully standalone device that remains operational even if the user completely breaks the Linux system. It allows to recover OS without needing an external computer or additional software.
story.z: [双处理器架构](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture)的理念是，即使用户完全破坏了Linux系统，Flipper One也能作为一个完全独立的设备保持运行。它允许在不需要外部计算机或额外软件的情况下恢复操作系统。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to a laptop with a single USB-C cable to get SSH console access and charge the device at the same time. No extra adapters are needed for Linux console access or power — Flipper One can simultaneously emulate a USB network adapter, a serial (COM port), or disk device.![Image 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)
story.z: 使用一根USB-C线缆将Flipper One连接到笔记本电脑，即可获得SSH控制台访问权限，并同时为设备充电。访问Linux控制台或供电无需额外的适配器——Flipper One可以同时模拟USB网络适配器、串行（COM端口）或磁盘设备！[图片 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)

story.x: *   Power IN/OUT — the USB-C1 port supports 5–20 V Power Delivery and can charge Flipper One or power your laptop.
story.z: * 电源输入/输出 — USB-C1 端口支持 5–20 V 电源传输，可为 Flipper One 充电或为您的笔记本电脑供电。

story.x: *   Device Emulation — the same port also emulates a USB network adapter, serial device, or disk drive. All at speeds of up to 5 Gbps.
story.z: * 设备仿真 — 同一端口还可仿真 USB 网络适配器、串行设备或磁盘驱动器。所有速度均高达 5 Gbps。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to an external display using a single USB Type-C cable and get a full desktop experience. ![Image 9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)
story.z: 使用一根USB Type-C线缆将Flipper One连接到外接显示器，即可获得完整的桌面体验。！[图片 9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)

story.x: *   USB DisplayPort Alt Mode — video output at 4K@120Hz to an external display over a single USB-C cable.
story.z: * USB DisplayPort 备用模式 — 通过单根 USB-C 线缆以 4K@120Hz 的分辨率将视频输出到外接显示器。

story.x: *   USB Host + Charging — connect peripherals such as a keyboard and mouse through your monitor’s USB hub while charging Flipper One over the same cable.
story.z: * USB主机 + 充电 — 通过显示器的USB集线器连接键盘和鼠标等外围设备，同时通过同一根线缆为Flipper One充电。

story.x: We wanted to make alternative firmware development for Flipper One easier. You can debug and perform a full system recovery through the same primary USB-C port (USB-C1). For most development tasks, you won't need a separate debugger.
story.z: 我们希望让Flipper One的替代固件开发变得更加容易。您可以通过同一个主USB-C端口（USB-C1）进行调试和执行完整系统恢复。对于大多数开发任务，您不需要单独的调试器。

story.x: Using the USB-C1 port, you can access the debug console & BOOTSEL mode for recovering the RP2350 MCU, and MaskROM mode for recovering the RK3576 CPU.
story.z: 使用 USB-C1 端口，您可以访问调试控制台和 BOOTSEL 模式以恢复 RP2350 MCU，以及 MaskROM 模式以恢复 RK3576 CPU。

story.x: *   2× Gigabit Ethernet— two independent WAN/LAN ports, each running at 1 Gbps. Can be used for a transparent bridge, MitM sniffing, and more.
story.z: * 2 个千兆以太网端口：两个独立的 WAN/LAN 端口，每个端口的运行速度均为 1 Gbps。可用于透明网桥、中间人攻击 (MitM) 嗅探等。

story.x: *   Wi-Fi 6E— based on the MT7921AUN chipset with monitor mode support. Covers 2.4/5/6 GHz bands and can run as both a Wi-Fi Client (STA) and a Hotspot (AP).
story.z: * Wi-Fi 6E— 基于 MT7921AUN 芯片组，支持监视模式。覆盖 2.4/5/6 GHz 频段，既可以作为 Wi-Fi 客户端 (STA) 运行，也可以作为热点 (AP) 运行。

story.x: *   Cellular modem— 5G or LTE modem via the M.2 expansion module, with support for external antennas. Accepts a physical Nano SIM (4FF) and eSIM.
story.z: * 蜂窝调制解调器——通过 M.2 扩展模块实现的 5G 或 LTE 调制解调器，支持外置天线。支持物理 Nano SIM 卡（4FF）和 eSIM 卡。

story.x: *   USB Ethernet— up to 5 Gbps emulated over USB-C. Connect your laptop or smartphone via a USB cable to add an extra network interface. Works via USB CDC-NCM, so no drivers are required.
story.z: * USB 以太网——通过 USB-C 模拟，速度高达 5 Gbps。通过 USB 线缆连接您的笔记本电脑或智能手机，即可添加额外的网络接口。通过 USB CDC-NCM 工作，因此无需驱动程序。

story.x: Out of the box, Flipper One can work as a gateway to any network, a multi-hotspot bridge, an inline Ethernet sniffer, a USB Wi-Fi/Ethernet adapter for a PC or phone.
story.z: Flipper One 开箱即用，可充当任何网络的网关、多热点桥接器、串联式以太网嗅探器、用于电脑或手机的 USB Wi-Fi/以太网适配器。

story.x: Analyze wired and wireless IP networks: discover active hosts, scan for open ports and services, detect network attacks and report anomalies. Flipper One comes with built-in apps for network analysis, mapping network topology, and detecting host misconfigurations.![Image 13](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/901/978/c2894be981d98c00ee8d0a063b05ceb1_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794772894&width=1360&sig=b8%2BQACZj70PNfVrKKT0uzYmMNTfFCY8OEM1kvDS5CGM%3D)It can also identify vulnerable and outdated services, act as a honeypot to detect network scanning activity, and save the results as exportable reports.

story.x: Interface is a ring with one button: press it, talk, and your words become a note, a message or a request to your AI agents, without taking out your phone. It works with NatureOS on iPhone and Android, and with your Mac or Windows computer.
story.z: Interface是一款带有一个按钮的戒指：按下按钮，说出您的话，这些话就会变成一条备忘、一条消息或向您的AI代理发出的请求，无需拿出手机。它可在iPhone和Android上与NatureOS配合使用，也可与您的Mac或Windows电脑配合使用。

story.x: Without a Membership, Interface tracks your health and records your notes as audio. Every recording is sent automatically, as an audio file, to the AI you already use, through a webhook.
story.z: 如果没有会员资格，Interface 会跟踪您的健康状况，并将您的备注以音频形式记录下来。每段录音都会以音频文件的形式，通过Webhook自动发送给您已经在使用的AI。

story.x: Membership ($9/month) adds our built-in AI: fast and accurate transcripts in 90+ languages, meeting recaps, dictation into any app, insights on your health, and a ready-to-use infrastructure for connecting multiple AI agents to your Interface. 3 to 6 months are included with your reward. If you stop, your ring keeps working with your own AI via webhook, and everything you recorded and transcribed stays yours.
story.z: 会员（$9/月）可使用我们的内置AI：90多种语言的快速准确转录、会议摘要、向任何应用听写、健康洞察，以及将多个AI代理连接到您的界面的即用型基础设施。您的奖励包含3至6个月的会员资格。如果您停止订阅，您的戒指将通过 Webhook 继续与您自己的 AI 配合工作，您录制和转录的所有内容仍归您所有。

story.x: Whisper in a waiting room, or speak up at a concert. When it's very quiet or very loud, bring the ring close to your lips. The rest of the time, just talk with your hand wherever it is.
story.z: 在候诊室里低声说话，或在音乐会上大声说话。当环境非常安静或非常嘈杂时，请将助听器靠近嘴唇。在其他时候，无论您的手在哪里，都可以直接说话。

story.x: Interface reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, sleep, skin temperature and activity, day and night. Log what you eat, your workouts, your supplements and how you feel, and your AI pairs it with your biometrics to give you insights made for you.
story.z: Interface全天候读取您的心率、心率变异性（HRV）、血氧、睡眠、体表温度和活动情况。记录您的饮食、锻炼、补充剂和感受，人工智能会将这些信息与您的生物特征数据相结合，为您提供个性化的洞察分析。

story.x: Your agents use your apps for you. Ask, and the agent you chose does the work. Anything that matters waits for your approval, and in NatureOS you choose which apps each agent can use.
story.z: 您的代理为您使用您的应用程序。您提出要求，您选择的代理就会为您完成任务。所有重要事项均需等待您的批准，在NatureOS中，您可以选择每个代理可以使用哪些应用程序。

story.x: Catch a thought before it's gone. Dictate an idea, a reminder or a name, and find it later in NatureOS, or let your agents organize it for you.

story.x: We spent two years refusing to pick. V2 carries 10,000 mAh and still sits 17.4 mm low at the front. It reports 8,000 times a second when you want speed, and runs up to 1,000 hours when you would rather forget the cable. Every key lights up, and the price still starts at $99.

story.x: Big battery and low front. Fast and long-lived. Bright and $99. All of it, at once.
story.z: 大电池，低前脸。快速且持久。明亮，售价 99 美元。所有优点，一应俱全。

story.x: First the sound. Two switch housings: Thock, deep and round; Clack, bright and short. Pick one, or both if you want.
story.z: 首先是声音。两种轴体外壳：Thock，声音低沉圆润；Clack，声音清脆短促。选择其一，或者如果您愿意，也可以两者兼有。

story.x: Then the feel. Three gasket mounts, soft, even and firm, that swap without tools.
story.z: 然后是手感。三个垫片支架，柔软、均匀且牢固，无需工具即可更换。

story.x: Under all of it, foams, rebuilt: six layers instead of five, so what reaches your ear is the key and nothing else. You will do this for years. Every keystroke should be one you look forward to.
story.z: 在所有这些之下，是经过重新设计的泡沫：由五层变为六层，因此传到您耳朵里的只有按键声，别无其他。您将多年如一日地使用它。每一次敲击键盘都应该让您充满期待。

story.x: 256 keyboards in one case.
story.z: 一个包装箱中有256个键盘。

story.x: Three gasket mounts, six foam layers, two switches. That is 256 ways to build one keyboard, or 512 if you own both switches. One press opens the case, every switch is hot-swap, and nothing needs solder or a screwdriver. Finding your sound takes minutes, not a weekend.
story.z: 三个垫片支架、六层泡棉、两个开关。这意味着有 256 种方式可以组装一个键盘，如果您同时拥有两种开关，则有 512 种方式。一按即可打开外壳，每个轴体均可热插拔，无需焊接或使用螺丝刀。找到您的专属声音只需几分钟，而不是一个周末。

story.x: Flipper One runs on completely open-source Linux firmware with a mainline kernel. This means full compatibility with the latest kernel versions:
story.z: Flipper One 运行于完全开源的 Linux 固件上，采用主线内核。这意味着与最新内核版本完全兼容：

story.x: *   Mainline Linux kernel support — full support in upstream Linux kernel.
story.z: * 主线 Linux 内核支持 — 在上游 Linux 内核中提供全面支持。

story.x: *   No binary blobs — no proprietary code or binaries in the boot process.
story.z: * 无二进制大对象 — 启动过程中没有专有代码或二进制文件。

story.x: *   No vendor-locked BSP — free from outdated vendor board support packages.
story.z: * 无供应商锁定 BSP — 无需使用过时的供应商板级支持包。

story.x: Our goal is to create a fully upstream-supported ARM computer that never becomes outdated, along with a well-documented platform giving the community maximum freedom to customize. To pull this off, we've [partnered with the Collabora team](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html), well-known contributors to the Linux kernel.
story.z: 我们的目标是打造一款完全由上游支持的 ARM 电脑，它永远不会过时，同时提供一个文档齐全的平台，让社区享有最大的定制自由。为了实现这一目标，我们[与 Collabora 团队](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html)建立了合作关系，该团队是 Linux 内核的知名贡献者。

story.x: *   Layer 0 (Zero) — Offline point-to-point access-control protocols: NFC, low-frequency RFID, Sub-1 GHz radio, Infrared, wired protocols like iButton, UART, SPI, I2C. Based on a low-power microcontroller.
story.z: *第0层（零层）— 离线点对点访问控制协议：NFC、低频RFID、Sub-1 GHz无线电、红外、有线协议（如iButton、UART、SPI、I2C）。基于低功耗微控制器。

story.x: *   Layer 1 (One) — Everything that's IP-connected: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, 5G, and satellite. It's all about networking, data transfer, and high-performance computing. An open Linux toolkit running on powerful hardware, enough computing power to handle SDR and local AI.
story.z: *第1层（一层）——所有通过IP连接的设备：Wi-Fi、以太网、5G和卫星。它与网络、数据传输和高性能计算息息相关。一个在强大硬件上运行的开放式Linux工具包，具备足够的计算能力来处理SDR和本地AI。

story.x: So they're not "newer" and "older" generations of the same product. Flipper One doesn't replace Flipper Zero — they're different categories of devices. Comparing them directly would be like comparing a hammer to a screwdriver.
story.z: 因此，它们并不是同一款产品的“更新”和“更旧”的代际产品。Flipper One 并不能取代 Flipper Zero，它们属于不同类别的设备。直接比较它们就像拿锤子和螺丝刀作比较。

story.x: *   Low-power MCU (Raspberry Pi RP2350) — manages LCD display, buttons, power and controls system boot stages.
story.z: * 低功耗 MCU（Raspberry Pi RP2350）— 管理液晶屏、按钮、电源并控制系统启动阶段。

story.x: *   High-performance CPU (Rockchip RK3576) — runs Linux kernel and user apps, and manages high-speed peripheral interfaces: Ethernet, Wi-Fi, PCIe, USB, HDMI, etc.
story.z: * 高性能 CPU（Rockchip RK3576）——运行 Linux 内核和用户应用程序，并管理高速外设接口：以太网、Wi-Fi、PCIe、USB、HDMI 等。

story.x: The idea behind the [2-processor architecture](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture) is to make Flipper One a fully standalone device that remains operational even if the user completely breaks the Linux system. It allows to recover OS without needing an external computer or additional software.
story.z: [双处理器架构](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture)的理念是，即使用户完全破坏了Linux系统，Flipper One也能作为一个完全独立的设备保持运行。它允许在不需要外接电脑或额外软件的情况下恢复操作系统。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to a laptop with a single USB-C cable to get SSH console access and charge the device at the same time. No extra adapters are needed for Linux console access or power — Flipper One can simultaneously emulate a USB network adapter, a serial (COM port), or disk device.![Image 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)
story.z: 使用一根USB-C线缆将Flipper One连接到笔记本电脑，即可获得SSH控制台访问权限，同时还能为设备充电。访问 Linux 控制台或供电无需额外的适配器——Flipper One 可以同时模拟 USB 网络适配器、串行（COM 端口）或磁盘设备！[图片 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)

story.x: *   Power IN/OUT — the USB-C1 port supports 5–20 V Power Delivery and can charge Flipper One or power your laptop.

story.x: Interface is a ring with one button: press it, talk, and your words become a note, a message or a request to your AI agents, without taking out your phone. It works with NatureOS on iPhone and Android, and with your Mac or Windows computer.
story.z: Interface是一款带有一个按钮的戒指：按下按钮并说话，您的言语就会变成一条备忘、一条消息或对AI代理的请求，无需拿出手机。它可在iPhone和Android上与NatureOS配合使用，也可与您的Mac或Windows电脑配合使用。

story.x: Without a Membership, Interface tracks your health and records your notes as audio. Every recording is sent automatically, as an audio file, to the AI you already use, through a webhook.
story.z: 如果没有会员资格，Interface 会跟踪您的健康状况，并将您的备注以音频形式记录下来。每段录音都会以音频文件的形式，通过Webhook自动发送给您已经在使用的AI。

story.x: Membership ($9/month) adds our built-in AI: fast and accurate transcripts in 90+ languages, meeting recaps, dictation into any app, insights on your health, and a ready-to-use infrastructure for connecting multiple AI agents to your Interface. 3 to 6 months are included with your reward. If you stop, your ring keeps working with your own AI via webhook, and everything you recorded and transcribed stays yours.
story.z: 会员（$9/月）可使用我们的内置AI：90多种语言的快速准确转录、会议摘要、向任何应用听写、健康洞察，以及将多个AI代理连接到您的Interface的即用型基础设施。您的奖励包含3至6个月的会员资格。如果您停止订阅，您的戒指将通过 Webhook 继续与您自己的 AI 配合工作，您录制和转录的所有内容都将归您所有。

story.x: Whisper in a waiting room, or speak up at a concert. When it's very quiet or very loud, bring the ring close to your lips. The rest of the time, just talk with your hand wherever it is.
story.z: 在候诊室里低声说话，或在音乐会上大声说话。当环境非常安静或非常嘈杂时，请将助听器靠近嘴唇。在其他时候，无论您的手在哪里，都可以直接说话。

story.x: Interface reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, sleep, skin temperature and activity, day and night. Log what you eat, your workouts, your supplements and how you feel, and your AI pairs it with your biometrics to give you insights made for you.
story.z: Interface全天候读取您的心率、HRV、血氧、睡眠、体表温度和活动情况。记录您的饮食、锻炼、补充剂以及您的感受，人工智能会将这些信息与您的生物特征数据相结合，为您提供量身定制的洞察分析。

story.x: Your agents use your apps for you. Ask, and the agent you chose does the work. Anything that matters waits for your approval, and in NatureOS you choose which apps each agent can use.
story.z: 您的代理为您使用您的应用程序。您提出要求，您选择的代理就会为您完成任务。所有重要事项均需等待您的批准，在 NatureOS 中，您可以选择每个代理可以使用哪些应用程序。

story.x: Catch a thought before it's gone. Dictate an idea, a reminder or a name, and find it later in NatureOS, or let your agents organize it for you.
story.z: 在念头消失之前捕捉它。口述一个想法、一条提醒或一个名字，稍后在NatureOS中找到它，或者让您的智能体为您整理。

story.x: Record a meeting and get the full transcript, who said what, and a recap with decisions and next steps. Later, just ask what you decided. The light on the ring shows when it's recording.
story.z: 录制会议并获取完整文字记录，包括发言人和发言内容，以及包含决策和后续步骤的摘要。稍后，只需询问你们决定了什么。环形灯亮起时表示正在录制。

story.x: Talk to your agents through HumanPods while your phone stays in your pocket. Ask a question, start a task or hear an update. With Interface, press the ring and ask, and hear the reply in your HumanPods.
story.z: 通过HumanPods与您的客服代表交谈，同时您的手机可以留在口袋里。提出问题、开始任务或听取最新消息。使用Interface，按下圆环并提问，然后在HumanPods中听到回复。

story.x: All of this lives in one ring of stainless steel, brushed, with polished edges, made to be worn every day.
story.z: 所有这一切都蕴含在一枚拉丝不锈钢戒指中，边缘经过抛光处理，适合日常佩戴。

story.x: Worn on your index finger, with the button facing your thumb. Waterproof.

story.x: Under all of it, foams, rebuilt: six layers instead of five, so what reaches your ear is the key and nothing else. You will do this for years. Every keystroke should be one you look forward to.

story.x: Why should your yard adapt to your mower?
story.z: 为什么您的庭院要适应您的割草机？

story.x: ARANIX adapts to your yard—the challenging conditions other robotic mowers often struggle with.
story.z: ARANIX 可适应您的庭院，而其他割草机器人往往难以应对其中的严苛条件。

story.x: From steep slopes and uneven ground to tight turns and complex layouts, it gives you complete confidence to let it mow—without spending time rescuing, trimming, or mowing what your robot leaves behind.
story.z: 从陡峭的斜坡和不平坦的地面，到急转弯和复杂的布局，它都能让您完全放心让它去割草，而无需花时间来补救、修剪或割掉机器人遗漏的草。

story.x: Because real lawns deserve a mower designed for real conditions.
story.z: 因为真正的草坪需要一款专为实际情况设计的割草机。

story.x: Each wheel is independently driven and steered. The Motion AI Agent combines perception of obstacles, terrain, slopes and available space with real-time analysis of resistance and traction at each wheel. It then coordinates the drive and steering of all four wheels to select and execute the most suitable maneuver, including zero-radius turns, diagonal movement, crab-style lateral movement and multi-step self-recovery.
story.z: 每个车轮均独立驱动和转向。Motion AI Agent将对障碍物、地形、坡度和可用空间的感知与对每个车轮的阻力和牵引力的实时分析相结合。然后，它协调所有四个车轮的驱动和转向，以选择并执行最合适的操纵动作，包括零半径转弯、对角线移动、螃蟹式横向移动和多步自救。

story.x: ARANIX performs true 0-radius turns without needing extra turning space. It moves effortlessly through narrow passages, tight corners, and complex lawn layouts, delivering smooth, uninterrupted mowing with fewer missed spots.
story.z: ARANIX能够实现真正的零半径转弯，无需额外的转弯空间。它能轻松穿过狭窄通道、拐角处和布局复杂的草坪，实现平稳、不间断的割草，漏割的区域更少。

story.x: Powered by AI, ARANIX intelligently switches between crab-walk and diagonal movement to maneuver in multiple directions. Compared with conventional steering, its omnidirectional mobility delivers smoother turns, faster recovery, and uninterrupted mowing across complex terrain.
story.z: ARANIX 由人工智能驱动，可在螃蟹步和对角线移动之间智能切换，从而实现多方向的操控。与传统转向相比，其全向移动性可实现更平稳的转弯、更快的恢复以及在复杂地形上的不间断割草。

story.x: Unlike conventional mowers that drag, crush, or scuff the lawn, ARANIX minimizes turf scuffing, grass flattening, and unnecessary pressure on the lawn, helping protect healthy growth while keeping your yard looking its best.
story.z: 与拖拽、碾压或磨损草坪的传统割草机不同，ARANIX最大限度地减少了草坪的磨损、草的压扁和对草坪的不必要压力，有助于保护草坪的健康生长，同时让您的庭院保持最佳外观。

story.x: With its omnidirectional mobility, ARANIX reaches deep into corners and along complex lawn edges with ease. It maximizes mowing coverage, reducing the need for manual touch-ups after mowing.
story.z: 凭借全向移动能力，ARANIX可以轻松深入角落和沿着复杂的草坪边缘作业。它最大限度地扩大了割草覆盖范围，减少了割草后人工修剪的需要。

story.x: ARANIX confidently climbs, turns, and moves laterally on slopes up to 40° (85%), maintaining outstanding stability and control for smooth, reliable mowing across challenging terrain.
story.z: ARANIX能够自信地在坡度高达40°（85%）的斜坡上攀爬、转向和横向移动，保持出色的稳定性和操控性，从而在崎岖的地形上实现平稳可靠的割草。

story.x: Each wheel adapts independently to uneven terrain, helping maintain continuous ground contact over roots, ruts, and bumps. By keeping the cutting deck stable, ARANIX delivers a cleaner, more consistent cut even across challenging lawns.
story.z: 每个车轮都能独立适应不平坦的地形，有助于在树根、车辙和颠簸处保持持续的地面接触。通过保持割草盘的稳定性，ARANIX即使在崎岖不平的草坪上也能实现更干净、更均匀的割草效果。

story.x: Easily climbs over roots, uneven ground, and overcomes obstacles up to 70mm (2.8 in) to maintain continuous, efficient mowing where other mowers struggle.
story.z: 轻松越过树根、不平坦的地面，并克服高达 70 毫米（2.8 英寸）的障碍物，在其他割草机难以胜任的地方保持持续、高效的割草。

story.x: Cut. Mulch. Nourish. All in one pass.
story.z: 割草。铺设覆盖物。滋养。一次完成。

story.x: Before every cut, FlowCut 2.0 uses powerful airflow lifts bent and flattened grass upright for improved blade contact. The result is a cleaner, more even cut with less tearing, helping keep your lawn healthier and better looking.
story.z: 在每次割草之前，FlowCut 2.0都会利用强劲的气流将弯曲和压扁的草抬起并立起，从而改善刀片与草的接触。这样一来，割草更加干净、均匀，撕裂更少，有助于保持草坪的健康和美观。

story.x: 18 staggered blades work with dual-layer cutting discs and integrated airflow to recut clippings into millimeter-sized pieces. Finer mulch breaks down faster, returning nutrients naturally to your lawn.
story.z: 18片错列式刀片与双层切割盘和集成气流配合工作，将剪下的草屑再次切割成毫米大小的碎屑。更细的覆盖物分解更快，将营养物质自然地归还给您的草坪。

story.x: Counter-rotating cutting discs and optimized airflow distribute fine grass clippings evenly across your lawn. With fewer clumps and less buildup beneath the deck, your lawn stays naturally nourished—no collection required.
story.z: 反向旋转的切割盘和优化的气流将细碎的草屑均匀地撒在草坪上。由于割草机机架下方堆积的草屑更少、结块更少，您的草坪将得到天然滋养，无需收集。

story.x: Handles tall, wet and tough grass with ease.
story.z: 轻松应对高大、潮湿和坚韧的草。

story.x: Switch between pivoting razor blade discs for everyday mowing and straight blade discs for more demanding mowing conditions. Adjust the cutting height from 25 to 95 mm to suit different grass types and seasonal growth, giving you greater flexibility for a consistently well-maintained lawn.
story.z: 在用于日常割草的旋转式剃刀刀盘和用于更苛刻割草条件的直刀盘之间切换。将割草高度从25毫米调整到95毫米，以适应不同草种和季节性生长，为您提供更大的灵活性，让草坪始终保持良好状态。

story.x: Dual high-output cutting motors maintain consistent blade speed through thick, dense, and demanding grass conditions. With powerful, reliable cutting performance, ARANIX delivers cleaner results while reducing slowdowns during every mow.
story.z: 双高功率切割电机可在草丛茂密、密集且刈割难度大的条件下保持刀片转速恒定。ARANIX具备强大而可靠的切割性能，在每次割草过程中都能提供更干净的作业效果，同时减少速度减慢的情况。

story.x: Wider coverage. Faster mowing. Fewer missed spots.
story.z: 覆盖范围更广。割草速度更快。漏割的区域更少。

story.x: The standard cutting deck mows within 3 cm of the lawn edge, while the dedicated edging module trims right up to the edge for true 0 cm edge cutting. Fewer uncut strips mean less manual trimming and a cleaner-looking lawn.
story.z: 标准割草盘可在距草坪边缘3厘米的范围内割草，而专用修边模块则可修剪至草坪边缘，实现真正的0厘米边缘修剪。未割草带更少，意味着需要进行的人工修剪更少，草坪外观也更整洁。

story.x: Multimodal AI fuses data from 360° LiDAR, 300° Vision SLAM and nRTK to understand the yard in real time, enabling centimeter-level navigation without relying on a single signal source.
story.z: 多模态人工智能融合了来自360°激光雷达、300°视觉SLAM和nRTK的数据，实时了解场地情况，从而实现厘米级导航，而无需依赖单一信号源。

story.x: With repeat positioning accuracy of up to ±2 cm, ARANIX follows planned mowing paths with exceptional precision. Accurate path tracking helps reduce missed areas while maintaining a clean, consistent finish.
story.z: ARANIX的重复定位精度高达±2厘米，能够以出色的精度遵循规划的割草路径。精确的路径跟踪有助于减少漏刈区域，同时保持整洁一致的刈割效果。

story.x: *nRTK is available on ARANIX 4000 and ARANIX 6000 only. Specifications vary by model and region.
story.z: *nRTK 仅在 ARANIX 4000 和 ARANIX 6000 上可用。规格因型号和地区而异。

story.x: No complicated antenna installation is required to get started. Auto mapping makes setup quick and intuitive, while optional nRTK is available whenever higher positioning precision is needed.
story.z: 无需进行复杂的天线安装即可开始使用。自动测绘使设置快速直观，而在需要更高定位精度时，可使用可选的 nRTK。

story.x: Even if RTK signals are temporarily unavailable, ARANIX can continue mowing areas of up to 2,000㎡ using its onboard perception system. No constant RTK, Wi-Fi, or 4G connection is required for reliable, uninterrupted mowing.
story.z: 即使RTK信号暂时不可用，ARANIX仍可使用其车载感知系统继续在面积达2,000㎡的区域内进行割草作业。无需持续的RTK、Wi-Fi或4G连接，即可实现可靠、不间断的割草。

story.x: Keyboards make you choose. A big battery means a thick case. Speed means charging every few days. Lights mean a higher price. You pick one and give up the other.
story.z: 键盘让您做出选择。大电池意味着厚机身。速度意味着每隔几天就要充电。灯光意味着更高的价格。您只能二选一。

story.x: We spent two years refusing to pick. V2 carries 10,000 mAh and still sits 17.4 mm low at the front. It reports 8,000 times a second when you want speed, and runs up to 1,000 hours when you would rather forget the cable. Every key lights up, and the price still starts at $99.
story.z: 我们花了两年时间，拒绝做出选择。V2 搭载 10000 mAh 电池，前部仍仅有 17.4 毫米厚。当您需要速度时，它每秒可报告 8,000 次；当您不想使用充电线时，它最长可运行 1,000 小时。每个按键都会亮起，起售价仍为 99 美元。

story.x: Big battery and low front. Fast and long-lived. Bright and $99. All of it, at once.
story.z: 大电池，低前脸。快速且持久。明亮，售价99美元。所有优点，一应俱全。

story.x: First the sound. Two switch housings: Thock, deep and round; Clack, bright and short. Pick one, or both if you want.
story.z: 首先是声音。两种轴体外壳：Thock，声音低沉圆润；Clack，声音清脆短促。选择一种，或者如果您愿意，也可以两种都选。

story.x: Then the feel. Three gasket mounts, soft, even and firm, that swap without tools.
story.z: 然后是手感。三个垫片支架，柔软、均匀且牢固，无需工具即可更换。

story.x: Under all of it, foams, rebuilt: six layers instead of five, so what reaches your ear is the key and nothing else. You will do this for years. Every keystroke should be one you look forward to.
story.z: 在所有这些之下，是经过重新设计的泡沫：由五层变为六层，因此传到您耳朵里的只有按键声，别无其他。您将使用它很多年。每一次敲击键盘都应该让您充满期待。

story.x: Hear the sound test:
story.z: 听到声音

story.x: 256 keyboards in one case.
story.z: 一个包装箱中有256个键盘。

story.x: Three gasket mounts, six foam layers, two switches. That is 256 ways to build one keyboard, or 512 if you own both switches. One press opens the case, every switch is hot-swap, and nothing needs solder or a screwdriver. Finding your sound takes minutes, not a weekend.
story.z: 三种垫片安装方式、六层泡棉、两种轴体。这意味着有 256 种方式可以组装一个键盘，如果您同时拥有两种开关，则有 512 种方式。按一下即可打开外壳，每个轴体均可热插拔，无需焊接或使用螺丝刀。找到您的专属声音只需几分钟，而不是一个周末。

story.x: Three gasket mounts. Swap them by hand.
story.z: 三个垫片支架。用手更换。

story.x: One press and the case is open. No screws, no tools.
story.z: 一按即可打开保护壳。无需螺丝，无需工具。

story.x: Flipper One runs on completely open-source Linux firmware with a mainline kernel. This means full compatibility with the latest kernel versions:
story.z: Flipper One 运行在完全开源的 Linux 固件上，采用主线内核。这意味着与最新内核版本完全兼容：

story.x: *   Mainline Linux kernel support — full support in upstream Linux kernel.
story.z: * 主线 Linux 内核支持 — 在上游 Linux 内核中提供全面支持。

story.x: *   No binary blobs — no proprietary code or binaries in the boot process.
story.z: * 无二进制 Blob — 启动过程中没有专有代码或二进制文件。

story.x: *   No vendor-locked BSP — free from outdated vendor board support packages.
story.z: * 无供应商锁定 BSP — 无需使用过时的供应商板级支持包。

story.x: Our goal is to create a fully upstream-supported ARM computer that never becomes outdated, along with a well-documented platform giving the community maximum freedom to customize. To pull this off, we've [partnered with the Collabora team](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html), well-known contributors to the Linux kernel.
story.z: 我们的目标是打造一款完全由上游支持的 ARM 计算机，它永远不会过时，同时提供一个文档齐全的平台，让社区享有最大的定制自由。为了实现这一目标，我们[与 Collabora 团队](https://www.collabora.com/news-and-blog/news-and-events/collabora-flipper-opening-up-the-rk3576.html)建立了合作关系，该团队是 Linux 内核的知名贡献者。

story.x: *   Layer 0 (Zero) — Offline point-to-point access-control protocols: NFC, low-frequency RFID, Sub-1 GHz radio, Infrared, wired protocols like iButton, UART, SPI, I2C. Based on a low-power microcontroller.
story.z: *第0（零）层 — 离线点对点访问控制协议：NFC、低频RFID、Sub-1 GHz无线电、红外、有线协议（如iButton、UART、SPI、I2C）。基于低功耗微控制器。

story.x: *   Layer 1 (One) — Everything that's IP-connected: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, 5G, and satellite. It's all about networking, data transfer, and high-performance computing. An open Linux toolkit running on powerful hardware, enough computing power to handle SDR and local AI.
story.z: * 第1层（一层）——所有通过IP连接的设备：Wi-Fi、以太网、5G和卫星。核心在于联网、数据传输和高性能计算。一个在强大硬件上运行的开放式Linux工具包，具备足够的算力来处理SDR和本地AI。

story.x: So they're not "newer" and "older" generations of the same product. Flipper One doesn't replace Flipper Zero — they're different categories of devices. Comparing them directly would be like comparing a hammer to a screwdriver.
story.z: 因此，它们并不是同一产品的“更新”和“更旧”的代际产品。Flipper One 并不取代 Flipper Zero——它们属于不同类别的设备。直接比较它们就像拿锤子和螺丝刀作比较。

story.x: *   Low-power MCU (Raspberry Pi RP2350) — manages LCD display, buttons, power and controls system boot stages.
story.z: * 低功耗 MCU（Raspberry Pi RP2350）——管理液晶屏、按钮、电源并控制系统启动阶段。

story.x: *   High-performance CPU (Rockchip RK3576) — runs Linux kernel and user apps, and manages high-speed peripheral interfaces: Ethernet, Wi-Fi, PCIe, USB, HDMI, etc.
story.z: * 高性能 CPU（Rockchip RK3576）——运行 Linux 内核和用户应用程序，并管理高速外设接口：以太网、Wi-Fi、PCIe、USB、HDMI 等。

story.x: The idea behind the [2-processor architecture](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture) is to make Flipper One a fully standalone device that remains operational even if the user completely breaks the Linux system. It allows to recover OS without needing an external computer or additional software.
story.z: [双处理器架构](https://docs.flipper.net/one/mcu-firmware/architecture)的理念是，即使用户完全破坏了Linux系统，Flipper One也能作为一个完全独立的设备保持运行。它允许在不需要外部计算机或额外软件的情况下恢复操作系统。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to a laptop with a single USB-C cable to get SSH console access and charge the device at the same time. No extra adapters are needed for Linux console access or power — Flipper One can simultaneously emulate a USB network adapter, a serial (COM port), or disk device.![Image 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)
story.z: 使用一根USB-C线缆将Flipper One连接到笔记本电脑，即可获得SSH控制台访问权限，并同时为设备充电。访问 Linux 控制台或为其供电无需额外的适配器——Flipper One 可以同时模拟 USB 网络适配器、串行（COM 端口）或磁盘设备！[图片 8](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/915/013/b36f023ae1f0579f18e918885b6d21ce_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794859211&width=1360&sig=y6mWufNb1H5cJeEzqLFRFm%2Bq4O%2Bze3PFFrDrUqXCzLo%3D)

story.x: *   Power IN/OUT — the USB-C1 port supports 5–20 V Power Delivery and can charge Flipper One or power your laptop.
story.z: * 电源输入/输出 — USB-C1 端口支持 5–20 V 电源传输，可为 Flipper One 充电或为您的笔记本电脑供电。

story.x: *   Device Emulation — the same port also emulates a USB network adapter, serial device, or disk drive. All at speeds of up to 5 Gbps.
story.z: * 设备仿真 — 同一端口还可仿真 USB 网络适配器、串行设备或磁盘驱动器。所有速度均高达 5 Gbps。

story.x: Connect Flipper One to an external display using a single USB Type-C cable and get a full desktop experience. ![Image 9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)
story.z: 使用一根 USB Type-C 线缆将 Flipper One 连接到外接显示器，即可获得完整的桌面体验。！[图片 9](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/055/923/658/b9093058f1922391792bcb0d1025bbd6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1794914956&width=1360&sig=ReYnTcSZBGfwNJG0M2AfTDJnHCQlsFHwcucui878umE%3D)

story.x: *   USB DisplayPort Alt Mode — video output at 4K@120Hz to an external display over a single USB-C cable.
story.z: * USB DisplayPort Alt 模式 — 通过单根 USB-C 线缆以 4K@120Hz 的分辨率向外接显示器输出视频。

story.x: *   USB Host + Charging — connect peripherals such as a keyboard and mouse through your monitor’s USB hub while charging Flipper One over the same cable.
story.z: * USB主机 + 充电 — 通过显示器的USB集线器连接键盘和鼠标等外围设备，同时通过同一根线缆为Flipper One充电。

story.x: We wanted to make alternative firmware development for Flipper One easier. You can debug and perform a full system recovery through the same primary USB-C port (USB-C1). For most development tasks, you won't need a separate debugger.
story.z: 我们希望让Flipper One的替代固件开发变得更加容易。您可以通过同一个主 USB-C 端口（USB-C1）进行调试和执行完整系统恢复。对于大多数开发任务，您不需要单独的调试器。

story.x: Using the USB-C1 port, you can access the debug console & BOOTSEL mode for recovering the RP2350 MCU, and MaskROM mode for recovering the RK3576 CPU.
story.z: 使用 USB-C1 端口，您可以访问调试控制台和 BOOTSEL 模式以恢复 RP2350 MCU，以及 MaskROM 模式以恢复 RK3576 CPU。

story.x: *   2× Gigabit Ethernet— two independent WAN/LAN ports, each running at 1 Gbps. Can be used for a transparent bridge, MitM sniffing, and more.

story.x: Keyboards make you choose. A big battery means a thick case. Speed means charging every few days. Lights mean a higher price. You pick one and give up the other.
story.z: 键盘让您不得不做出选择。大电池意味着厚机身。速度意味着每隔几天就要充电。灯光意味着更高的价格。您只能二选一。

story.x: We spent two years refusing to pick. V2 carries 10,000 mAh and still sits 17.4 mm low at the front. It reports 8,000 times a second when you want speed, and runs up to 1,000 hours when you would rather forget the cable. Every key lights up, and the price still starts at $99.
story.z: 我们花了两年时间，拒绝做出选择。V2 搭载 10000 mAh 电池，前部厚度仍仅为 17.4 毫米。当您需要速度时，它每秒可报告 8000 次；当您不想使用充电线时，它最长可运行 1000 小时。每个按键都会亮起，起售价仍为 99 美元。

story.x: Big battery and low front. Fast and long-lived. Bright and $99. All of it, at once.
story.z: 大电池，低前置。快速且持久。明亮，售价 99 美元。所有优点，一应俱全。

story.x: First the sound. Two switch housings: Thock, deep and round; Clack, bright and short. Pick one, or both if you want.
story.z: 首先是声音。两种轴体外壳：Thock，声音低沉圆润；Clack，声音清脆短促。选择一种，或者如果您愿意，也可以两种都选。

story.x: Then the feel. Three gasket mounts, soft, even and firm, that swap without tools.
story.z: 然后是手感。三个垫片支架，柔软、均匀且稳固，无需工具即可更换。

story.x: Under all of it, foams, rebuilt: six layers instead of five, so what reaches your ear is the key and nothing else. You will do this for years. Every keystroke should be one you look forward to.
story.z: 在所有这些之下，是经过重新设计的泡沫：由五层变为六层，因此传到您耳朵里的只有按键声，别无其他。您将使用它很多年。每一次敲击键盘都应该让您充满期待。

story.x: Hear the sound test:
story.z: 听到声音

story.x: 256 keyboards in one case.
story.z: 一个包装箱中装有256个键盘。

story.x: Three gasket mounts, six foam layers, two switches. That is 256 ways to build one keyboard, or 512 if you own both switches. One press opens the case, every switch is hot-swap, and nothing needs solder or a screwdriver. Finding your sound takes minutes, not a weekend.
story.z: 三个垫片支架、六层泡棉、两个开关。这意味着有 256 种方式可以组装一个键盘，如果您同时拥有两种轴体，则有 512 种方式。一按即可打开外壳，每个轴体均可热插拔，无需焊接或使用螺丝刀。找到您的专属声音只需几分钟，而不是一个周末。

story.x: Three gasket mounts. Swap them by hand.

story.x: One press and the case is open. No screws, no tools.

story.x: Why should your yard adapt to your mower?
story.z: 为什么您的庭院要适应您的割草机？

story.x: ARANIX adapts to your yard—the challenging conditions other robotic mowers often struggle with.
story.z: ARANIX 可适应您的庭院——其他割草机器人往往难以应对的严苛条件。

story.x: From steep slopes and uneven ground to tight turns and complex layouts, it gives you complete confidence to let it mow—without spending time rescuing, trimming, or mowing what your robot leaves behind.
story.z: 从陡峭的斜坡和不平坦的地面，到急转弯和复杂的布局，它让您完全放心让它去割草——无需花费时间来补救、修剪或割掉机器人遗漏的草。

story.x: Because real lawns deserve a mower designed for real conditions.
story.z: 因为真正的草坪需要一款专为真实条件设计的割草机。

story.x: Each wheel is independently driven and steered. The Motion AI Agent combines perception of obstacles, terrain, slopes and available space with real-time analysis of resistance and traction at each wheel. It then coordinates the drive and steering of all four wheels to select and execute the most suitable maneuver, including zero-radius turns, diagonal movement, crab-style lateral movement and multi-step self-recovery.
story.z: 每个车轮都独立驱动和转向。Motion AI Agent将对障碍物、地形、坡度和可用空间的感知与对每个车轮的阻力和牵引力的实时分析相结合。然后，它协调所有四个车轮的驱动和转向，以选择并执行最合适的操纵动作，包括零半径转弯、对角线移动、螃蟹式横向移动和多步自救。

story.x: ARANIX performs true 0-radius turns without needing extra turning space. It moves effortlessly through narrow passages, tight corners, and complex lawn layouts, delivering smooth, uninterrupted mowing with fewer missed spots.
story.z: ARANIX能够实现真正的零半径转弯，无需额外的转弯空间。它能轻松穿过狭窄通道、拐角处和布局复杂的草坪，实现平稳、不间断的割草，漏割的区域更少。

story.x: Powered by AI, ARANIX intelligently switches between crab-walk and diagonal movement to maneuver in multiple directions. Compared with conventional steering, its omnidirectional mobility delivers smoother turns, faster recovery, and uninterrupted mowing across complex terrain.
story.z: ARANIX 由人工智能驱动，可在螃蟹步和对角线移动之间智能切换，从而实现多方向的操控。与传统转向相比，其全向移动性可实现更平稳的转弯、更快的恢复以及在复杂地形上的不间断割草。

story.x: Unlike conventional mowers that drag, crush, or scuff the lawn, ARANIX minimizes turf scuffing, grass flattening, and unnecessary pressure on the lawn, helping protect healthy growth while keeping your yard looking its best.
story.z: 与拖拽、碾压或磨损草坪的传统割草机不同，ARANIX最大限度地减少了草坪的磨损、草的压扁和对草坪的不必要压力，有助于保护草坪的健康生长，同时让您的庭院保持最佳外观。

story.x: With its omnidirectional mobility, ARANIX reaches deep into corners and along complex lawn edges with ease. It maximizes mowing coverage, reducing the need for manual touch-ups after mowing.
story.z: 凭借全向移动能力，ARANIX可以轻松深入角落，并沿着复杂的草坪边缘行进。它最大限度地扩大了割草覆盖范围，减少了割草后人工修剪的需要。

story.x: ARANIX confidently climbs, turns, and moves laterally on slopes up to 40° (85%), maintaining outstanding stability and control for smooth, reliable mowing across challenging terrain.
story.z: ARANIX能够自信地在坡度高达40°（85%）的斜坡上攀爬、转向和横向移动，保持出色的稳定性和操控性，从而在崎岖的地形上实现平稳可靠的割草。

story.x: Each wheel adapts independently to uneven terrain, helping maintain continuous ground contact over roots, ruts, and bumps. By keeping the cutting deck stable, ARANIX delivers a cleaner, more consistent cut even across challenging lawns.
story.z: 每个车轮都能独立适应不平坦的地形，有助于在树根、车辙和颠簸处保持持续的地面接触。通过保持割草盘的稳定性，ARANIX即使在崎岖不平的草坪上也能实现更干净、更均匀的割草效果。

story.x: Easily climbs over roots, uneven ground, and overcomes obstacles up to 70mm (2.8 in) to maintain continuous, efficient mowing where other mowers struggle.
story.z: 轻松越过树根、不平地面，并克服高达70毫米（2.8英寸）的障碍物，在其他割草机难以胜任的地方保持持续、高效的割草。

story.x: Cut. Mulch. Nourish. All in one pass.
story.z: 割草。铺设覆盖物。滋养。一次完成。

story.x: Before every cut, FlowCut 2.0 uses powerful airflow lifts bent and flattened grass upright for improved blade contact. The result is a cleaner, more even cut with less tearing, helping keep your lawn healthier and better looking.
story.z: 每次割草前，FlowCut 2.0都会利用强劲气流将弯曲和压扁的草抬起并立起，以改善刀片接触。这样一来，割草效果更干净、更均匀，撕裂更少，有助于保持草坪的健康和美观。

story.x: 18 staggered blades work with dual-layer cutting discs and integrated airflow to recut clippings into millimeter-sized pieces. Finer mulch breaks down faster, returning nutrients naturally to your lawn.
story.z: 18片交错排列的刀片与双层切割盘和集成气流配合工作，将剪下的草屑再次切割成毫米大小的碎屑。更细的覆盖物分解得更快，将营养物质自然地归还给您的草坪。

story.x: Counter-rotating cutting discs and optimized airflow distribute fine grass clippings evenly across your lawn. With fewer clumps and less buildup beneath the deck, your lawn stays naturally nourished—no collection required.
story.z: 反向旋转的切割盘和优化的气流将细碎的草屑均匀地撒在草坪上。由于割草机机架下方积聚的草屑更少、结块更少，您的草坪将得到天然滋养，无需收集。

story.x: Handles tall, wet and tough grass with ease.
story.z: 轻松应对高大、潮湿和坚韧的草。

story.x: Switch between pivoting razor blade discs for everyday mowing and straight blade discs for more demanding mowing conditions. Adjust the cutting height from 25 to 95 mm to suit different grass types and seasonal growth, giving you greater flexibility for a consistently well-maintained lawn.
story.z: 在用于日常割草的旋转剃刀刀盘和用于更苛刻割草条件的直刀盘之间切换。将割草高度从25毫米调整到95毫米，以适应不同草种和季节性生长，为您提供更大的灵活性，让草坪始终保持良好状态。

story.x: Dual high-output cutting motors maintain consistent blade speed through thick, dense, and demanding grass conditions. With powerful, reliable cutting performance, ARANIX delivers cleaner results while reducing slowdowns during every mow.
story.z: 双高功率切割电机可在草地茂密、密集且条件苛刻的情况下保持刀片转速的恒定。ARANIX具备强大而可靠的切割性能，在每次割草过程中都能提供更干净的作业效果，同时减少速度减慢的情况。

story.x: Wider coverage. Faster mowing. Fewer missed spots.
story.z: 覆盖范围更广。割草速度更快。漏割的区域更少。

story.x: The standard cutting deck mows within 3 cm of the lawn edge, while the dedicated edging module trims right up to the edge for true 0 cm edge cutting. Fewer uncut strips mean less manual trimming and a cleaner-looking lawn.
story.z: 标准割草盘可在距草坪边缘3厘米的范围内割草，而专用修边模块则可修剪至草坪边缘，实现真正的0厘米边缘修剪。未割草带更少，意味着需要进行的人工修剪更少，草坪看起来也更整洁。

story.x: Multimodal AI fuses data from 360° LiDAR, 300° Vision SLAM and nRTK to understand the yard in real time, enabling centimeter-level navigation without relying on a single signal source.
story.z: 多模态人工智能融合来自360°激光雷达、300°视觉SLAM和nRTK的数据，实时了解场地情况，实现厘米级导航，而无需依赖单一信号源。

story.x: With repeat positioning accuracy of up to ±2 cm, ARANIX follows planned mowing paths with exceptional precision. Accurate path tracking helps reduce missed areas while maintaining a clean, consistent finish.
story.z: ARANIX的重复定位精度高达±2厘米，能够以出色的精度遵循规划的割草路径。精确的路径跟踪有助于减少漏刈区域，同时保持整洁一致的刈草效果。

story.x: *nRTK is available on ARANIX 4000 and ARANIX 6000 only. Specifications vary by model and region.
story.z: *nRTK 仅在 ARANIX 4000 和 ARANIX 6000 上可用。规格因型号和地区而异。

story.x: No complicated antenna installation is required to get started. Auto mapping makes setup quick and intuitive, while optional nRTK is available whenever higher positioning precision is needed.
story.z: 无需进行复杂的天线安装即可开始使用。自动测绘使设置快速直观，而当需要更高的定位精度时，可选择使用 nRTK。

story.x: Even if RTK signals are temporarily unavailable, ARANIX can continue mowing areas of up to 2,000㎡ using its onboard perception system. No constant RTK, Wi-Fi, or 4G connection is required for reliable, uninterrupted mowing.
story.z: 即使RTK信号暂时不可用，ARANIX仍可使用其车载感知系统继续在面积达2000㎡的区域内进行割草作业。无需持续的RTK、Wi-Fi或4G连接，即可实现可靠、不间断的割草。
